messages:
alex: Quick check — pinning the 2026-03-20 release to v2.4.1 and sending the internal RN at 16:00 PT. Can ops and eng-sre confirm rollback lanes? :eyes:

maya: 👍 Pin confirmed. Rollback lanes: primary -> v2.4.0, fallback -> hotfix/2026.03.20. I'll add both to the runbook and pin the snippet in staging ops doc.

jesse: RN copy looks fine. One small dev note: call out the model-quant patch (regresses one rare embedding case). I'll push a tiny wording tweak in 5m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: announcement draft uploaded to #eng-releases. Canary job scheduled to start at 16:10 PT. Will post status updates here.

riley: On-call window confirmed 15:45-18:00 PT. If canary error rate >5% sustained for 5m or latency regresses >20%, I'll kick rollback.

alex: thanks. maya, can you add the rollback command snippet to the runbook and paste it here? e.g.:

```bash
./releasectl rollback --to v2.4.0 --reason "canary errors"
```

maya: snippet added to runbook and pinned. Also added the metric thresholds (5% errors over 5m, 20% 95th latency uplift).

jesse: updated RN diff includes: short blurb, known issue note (embedding mismatch on >4k tokens), and QA advisory. Approving the final text.

emma: Comms: we'll send internal blast with subject "Internal: Release v2.4.1 — 16:00 PT". Where should I link the canary dashboard? Use: https://dash.internal/release/1844449999

alex: that dashboard link works. Add a very short "what to do if you see regressions" section: contact @riley and run the rollback snippet.

riley: added a 3-step checklist to the message: 1) Verify canary errors on dashboard 2) Escalate to eng-sre 3) Run rollback command.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started at 16:10 PT — routing 10% traffic to v2.4.1. Monitoring for 20 minutes.

riley: watching metrics now. Will call abort if thresholds breached. :mag:

alex: Final plan: blast at 16:00 PT, start canary at 16:10 PT, ops standby 16:00-17:30 PT. Thanks everyone — going to send the blast in 3m :rocket:
